profile.summary: Monteil Limited designs, manufactures, markets, and distributes ready-made garments in India. The company offers formal, semi-formal, and casual wears for men under the Monteil brand name. It sells its products through retail outlets, online, and third-party e-commerce marketplaces. The company was formerly known as Lorenzini Apparels Limited and changed its name to Monteil Limited in October 2026
